scope: Physical Baltic CP775 BIOS and DOS input, DOS=LOW, real IBM keyboards identified per run. All required national letters in both cases and every reference dead-key pair remain reachable with physical legacy keys. Country API checks before and after DISPLAY/KEYB activation. Does not qualify legacy reload/pending-state failures, font-plane bytes or rendered glyphs, installed paths, complete text/filename workflows, or the final source-matched release composition.
hardware_exclusions: No separate right Alt/Ctrl or scan-86 ISO key. Left Ctrl+Alt provides third level.
Navigation uses the legacy keypad with Num Lock restored and AL=00 rather than enhanced AL=E0. Literal CP775 E0 is preserved.
oracle: Retained FreeDOS keyboard expectations and CP775 required-letter manifest, independently captured before table generation. The legacy adapter asserts national-letter and dead-pair reachability after hardware filtering.
remaining: Legacy selection/reload/pending-state and resource failure cases.
Real-BIOS font capture, installed profiles, complete workflows and final release qualification.

The successful runs record reconnect counts; those counts also include normal BIOS startup waits.
